name: Frequent Subgraph Mining
shortfall_explanation: The contract uses support across a collection of graph transactions. GraphMiner/Pangolin use single-graph MNI support and are cataloged separately in problem 68.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
